card.title: Service, a Divine Quality
card.speaker: Carlos H. Amado
card.shortDescription: A General Conference address connecting Christian discipleship, Christlike service, and building the kingdom.
card.relevance: Useful as a modern prophetic witness when evaluating claims that service to others is connected with service to God.

card.title: Helping the Poor and Distressed
card.speaker: Dallin H. Oaks
card.roleAtTime: First Counselor in the First Presidency
card.shortDescription: A General Conference address on caring for people in need.
card.relevance: Useful for evaluating whether a scripture interpretation about service accounts for concrete care for others.

card.title: Worship
card.speaker: D. Todd Christofferson
card.shortDescription: A recent General Conference address on worship.
card.relevance: Useful when a claim treats service, devotion, Sabbath observance, or ordinances as dimensions of worship.

card.title: The Greatest among You
card.speaker: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
card.roleAtTime: Second Counselor in the First Presidency
card.shortDescription: A General Conference address emphasizing humble, service-oriented leadership.
card.relevance: Useful for evaluating interpretations of righteous leadership, especially when paired with D&C 121.

card.title: Only upon the Principles of Righteousness
card.speaker: Larry Y. Wilson
card.sourceTitle: Only upon the Principles of Righteousness
card.shortDescription: A General Conference address focused on righteous influence and priesthood principles.
card.relevance: Useful when evaluating claims about power, influence, leadership, and D&C 121.

card.title: King Benjamin: In the Service of Your God
card.author: Susan Easton Black
card.publication: Religious Studies Center, Brigham Young University
card.mainContribution: Connects King Benjamin's sermon, revealed knowledge, and service to God and humanity.
card.shortDescription: A chapter-length LDS scholarly treatment of King Benjamin and service.
card.relevance: Useful for evaluating interpretations of Mosiah 2:17 and King Benjamin's theology of service.

card.title: Service and Temple in King Benjamin's Speech
card.author: Donald W. Parry
card.publication: Journal of Book of Mormon Studies
card.mainContribution: Explores service language in King Benjamin's speech in relation to temple themes.
card.shortDescription: A journal article on service and temple themes in Mosiah.
card.relevance: Useful for checking whether a service-focused reading of Mosiah 2:17 has broader literary and ritual context.

card.title: How Are Acts of Service Related to Wisdom?
card.author: Scripture Central
card.mainContribution: Summarizes research connecting King Benjamin's service teaching with wisdom traditions.
card.shortDescription: A concise research-summary article on Mosiah 2:17, wisdom, and service.
card.relevance: Useful as a lightweight scholarly source card for service/wisdom readings of Mosiah 2:17.

card.title: Section 121
card.author: Steven C. Harper
card.publication: Doctrine and Covenants Contexts, BYU Studies
card.mainContribution: Places D&C 121 in the historical and textual context of Joseph Smith's Liberty Jail letters.
card.shortDescription: A historical-context essay for Doctrine and Covenants 121.
card.relevance: Useful for evaluating leadership or power claims that rely on D&C 121.

card.title: The Textual Context of Doctrine and Covenants 121-23
card.author: Ryan J. Wessel
card.mainContribution: Examines the larger letters and textual setting behind D&C 121-123.
card.shortDescription: A Religious Educator article on the textual context of D&C 121-123.
card.relevance: Useful for checking whether interpretations of D&C 121 account for the surrounding source document.
